name: O
source:
"Are my abdominal muscles that pleasing?”

O the Owl, buff warden and host of the Woodland Forest Dating show. He maintains order and is impartial, but he has a soft spot for the main character, and subtly tries to help her when she needs it. Although O is mature, wise, and distinguished, he’s a bird of prey who’s not only in top shape, but retains his animal physique and instinctively deploys his wings and talons as needed. For all intents and purposes, O is a gracious host, not a contestant… but this game is nuts.

[From official profile]
